title: MorningBriefConfig
description: Morning Brief configuration (marquee #10, Phase 5). Autonomous daily briefing generator that reviews overnight activity and pre-drafts follow-up Stitches.

window_hours.description: How many hours back to look for overnight activity (default: 24, max: 168/7 days)

schedule_hour.description: Hour of day (0-23) to auto-run the brief in local time (default: 7 = 7 AM)

auto_run_enabled.description: Whether the scheduled auto-run is enabled (default: true)
